verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs describe a first-party in-browser toolbar that covers each part of the story: leaving feedback, managing flags and inspecting performance. Separate docs confirm that comments work on both preview and production environments, which covers the live-site part. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the toolbar's flag-management and performance-inspection features, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the toolbar works on live production sites.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage feature flags, and inspect performance directly on my live site

citations.quote: An in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage flags, preview drafts, and inspect performance.
Let teams and invited collaborators comment on your preview and production environments.
